# SC-13: The Friday email lists the week's exceptions-list lines

## Steps
1. Send the 3 test purchase orders with one altered code each during the test week.
2. On Friday after 16:00, open the order coordinator's inbox.

## Expected result
The email lists every exceptions-list line of the week: all 3 (3 cases).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: 3 test purchase orders with one altered code each; records: the 3 test orders; count: 3; fields: product code, reason.
